authority_boundary: Validates interface findability and comprehension only, never biomechanical, software-correctness, coaching, clinical, or population claims.

null_negative_findings.description: General readers without developer background exhibited slower location of provider git commit SHAs (median 62.4s vs 28.5s for technical reviewers).
null_negative_findings.implication: Added explicit cross-links from textbook chapter footnotes directly to programming catalog provenance entries.
null_negative_findings.observed_effect: 3 out of 12 general readers initially looked in website bibliography rather than programming provenance.

null_negative_findings.description: Non-technical readers found raw JSON workflow output verification less intuitive than visual summary tables.
null_negative_findings.implication: Programming catalog includes both structured JSON schema definitions and rendered Markdown summary tables for all workflow artifacts.
null_negative_findings.observed_effect: Task 5 completion was 91.7% in general readers vs 100% in technical reviewers.

exclusion_criteria: Prior author or direct maintainer involvement in AffineDrift codebase
Automated bot traffic or unconsented automated crawlers
hypotheses: H1: Readers in both technical-reviewer and general-reader cohorts can identify the reader-facing evidence state and quote what it does not establish with >=85% accuracy.
H2: Readers can locate the exact provider record and commit SHA within 60 seconds of navigation without encountering dead-end routes.
H3: Readers distinguish simulated model output from measured participant empirical data with >=90% accuracy.
preregistration.primary_outcome: Binary task completion rate and composite evidence comprehension score across all 6 standardized tasks.
secondary_outcomes: Reader self-reported confidence score (1 to 5 Likert scale)

remediation_issues.title: Add direct Provenance link to article and monograph navigation bars
Enhance visual affordance for workflow artifact inspection in catalog pages

tasks.description: Navigate from home or resources to the 35-chapter technical monograph.
tasks.success_criterion: Reader lands on canonical monograph entry point within 90 seconds.
tasks.title: Find Proximal-Distal Monograph

tasks.description: Identify the evidence state badge and state what is not established.
tasks.expected_target: Evidence state card and badge on monograph route
tasks.success_criterion: Reader identifies simulation tier and quotes authority boundary note.
tasks.title: Identify Evidence State & Negative Scope

tasks.description: Locate the exact upstream provider record and pinned source commit SHA.
tasks.success_criterion: Reader identifies exact commit SHA and SHA-256 manifest hash.
tasks.title: Locate Provider Record & Commit SHA

tasks.description: Explain at least one governed limitation or falsification condition.
tasks.success_criterion: Reader names model boundary without claiming general human validity.
tasks.title: Explain Limitation or Falsifier

tasks.description: Find a computational program or workflow and inspect an artifact.
tasks.success_criterion: Reader inspects execution parameters, exit codes, and outputs.
tasks.title: Inspect Program and Workflow Artifact

tasks.description: Demonstrate comprehension that simulation results are not human trials.
tasks.expected_target: Research readiness library and evidence badges
tasks.success_criterion: Reader accurately categorizes synthetic runs vs clinical trials.
tasks.title: Distinguish Model Output from Participant Evidence
